findings.rule: margin = smoothed / threshold - 1; called marginal below 50%
findings.text: The smoothed score (96,205) exceeded the threshold (52,942) by +81.7%.

findings.rule: fires when the raw score at the alert bin is below the threshold
findings.text: The alert bin's own raw score was 154,559 (2.92× the threshold), so the alert does not rest on carried-over evidence alone. The smoothed score one bin earlier, at 10:05, follows from the EWMA update as 81,616.

findings.rule: largest one-bin rise in smoothed-contribution calibration percentile among displayed groups; abrupt when the rise is at least 0.50 and ends at or above 0.99; elevated at start when the dominant group starts at or above 0.99
findings.text: No abrupt one-bin emergence: the largest rise was dv_pressure, from percentile 57.18 at 09:50 to 87.86 at 09:55.

findings.rule: lists single-group model-space repairs that clear the alert; non-specific when more than one does
findings.text: Only the tp2 repair clears this alert (repaired smoothed score 13,460 against the 52,942 threshold). This tests detector dependence, not a physical repair.

findings.rule: fires when a clearing repair leaves the smoothed score at or above the threshold
findings.text: Every repair that clears the alert also brings the smoothed score below the threshold.

findings.rule: counts candidates in play; candidates are never ranked
findings.text: All candidate explanations in play remain open; the loaded evidence does not rank or separate them.

findings.rule: reports training interquartile ranges of the case's measured-context features and where the alert-bin value falls
findings.text: Training-period ranges are narrow for some features (for example tp2__mean: interquartile range -0.0121 to -0.00853), so small physical changes become large scaled residuals. At the alert bin, tp2__mean, tp2__min and tp2__max were above the training interquartile range.

findings.rule: fires when the past-only window is incomplete
findings.text: All bins of the past-only window are present (12 of 12).

findings.rule: always present: leak and demand are not separately identifiable without a demand observation
findings.text: Leakage and higher downstream demand both raise total outflow (total outflow = demand + leakage). Without an independent demand measurement this data cannot tell them apart.

findings.rule: always present while the physical bridge is not validated
